title: Associate Vice President, Model & AI Governance
description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Associate Vice President, Model & AI Governance, is the enterprise leader responsible for establishing and overseeing the organization’s framework for model governance, artificial intelligence (AI) risk management, responsible AI and AI governance.
Reporting to the Chief Audit & Risk Officer, this executive provides independent second-line oversight and challenge of the organization’s use of models, advanced analytics, machine learning, generative AI, and emerging AI technologies. The role establishes the governance, risk-management, control, monitoring and escalation framework necessary to ensure AI models are deployed in a manner that is safe, ethical, transparent, explainable, compliant, secure and aligned with the organization’s mission and risk appetite.
The Associate Vice President, Model & AI Governance, partners closely with executive leadership, technology, data and analytics, clinical/business leaders, compliance, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, information security, internal audit, enterprise risk management and other control functions to ensure AI-related risks are identified, assessed, governed, monitored, and appropriately reported.
This leader will serve as an advisor to executive management on emerging model and AI risks, while maintaining appropriate independence from the teams developing and deploying models and AI solutions. Key Responsibilities

• Own and continuously enhance the enterprise model governance framework, including model identification, inventory, classification, risk tiering, development, validation, approval, implementation, monitoring, change management, retirement and documentation.

• Define model risk appetite, risk taxonomy, minimum control standards, governance requirements and escalation thresholds.

• Provide effective challenge over model development, validation, implementation, monitoring and performance.

• Oversee the enterprise model inventory and ensure appropriate ownership, accountability, documentation, and risk classification.

• Establish standards for model validation, including conceptual soundness, performance, stability, data quality, bias, explainability and ongoing monitoring.

• Ensure appropriate governance over third-party and externally developed models.

• Develop and oversee the organization’s Responsible AI framework and principles.

• Establish governance standards addressing fairness, bias, transparency, explainability, accountability, privacy, human oversight, safety, security, and appropriate use of AI.

• Establish processes for AI use-case risk intake, risk assessment, approval, monitoring, and ongoing oversight, working closely with other AI governance functions to simplify and streamline processes.

• Develop standards for responsible use of generative AI, large language models, AI agents, automated decision-making and other emerging technologies, partnering with other stakeholders to ensure cross functional alignment

• Establish governance mechanisms to identify and address unintended consequences, model drift, hallucination, discrimination, explainability limitations, and other AI-specific risks.

• Own the enterprise AI risk management framework and associated governance processes.

• Establish governance requirements and oversight for the enterprise AI inventory, ensuring AI applications and use cases are appropriately inventoried, classified, risk-rated, assigned accountable ownership, and monitored throughout their lifecycle.

• Develop AI risk assessments and approval requirements proportionate to the potential impact of technology.

• Establish ongoing monitoring of AI performance, effectiveness, risk indicators, incidents, exceptions and emerging threats.

• Partner with cybersecurity, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Data Governance, and Technology Risk to address AI-specific risks.

• Establish governance for the use of external AI providers, foundation models, APIs, AI platforms, and third-party AI solut

3165 - Account Director, Data Operations  - GCS

Role Summary and Impact

 

The Data Delivery & Project Manager is responsible for the end-to-end coordination, quality assurance, and governance of media data within the Cockpit programme across multiple markets. Acting as the central point of contact between local market teams, global Nestlé stakeholders, and external data partners, this role ensures the timely delivery of accurate, high-quality data that supports MMM modelling and business decision-making. The successful candidate will drive process consistency, manage complex stakeholder relationships, resolve data-related issues, and oversee programme timelines to ensure smooth and efficient execution across all participating markets.

Data Delivery and Project Management

Own and maintain the Cockpit refresh calendar for  all participating markets, ensuring alignment with MMM modelling timelines.

• Coordinate with local market teams, data processing vendors (e.g., Redmill), and global & z-EUR Nestle to ensure timely submission of accurate data to meet cockpit calendar.

• Manage ad-hoc refresh requests and assess feasibility against resource and process constraints.

Data Quality Assurance

• Review and validate incoming media plan data for completeness, accuracy, and adherence to agreed formats (e.g., no channels with impressions but zero spend).

• Perform central QA checks before data is loaded into Cockpit, or oversee local QA when/if decentralised.

• Investigate and resolve data discrepancies (e.g., spend, impressions, reach) with local teams.

Process Governance & Standardisation

• E nforce agreed actualisation processes f or Cockpit markets

• Ensure consistent application of data governance rules, including mandatory metrics, cost allocation, and added value treatment.

Stakeholder Management

Act as the  central point of contact for the cockpit program  between:

• Local OpenMind (OM) market teams

• Global Nestlé stakeholders (e.g., Z-EUR, IT)

• Data processing vendors (e.g., Redmill)

• Facilitate alignment calls to resolve blockers and ensure all parties are informed of timelines, dependencies, and changes.

• Communicate clearly on delays, risks, and mitigation plans.

Primary Skills

• Strong background in media planning, buying, or media operations with a deep understanding of campaign structures, channels, and metrics.

• Experience managing multi-market data workflows and working with multiple stakeholders across geographies.

• Proven ability to interpret and troubleshoot media data (spend, impressions, reach, CPM/CPC calculations).

• Strong project management skills, able to manage multiple deadlines and priorities in a fast-moving environment.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical data issues to non-technical stakeholders.

• High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At  Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.”  learn more about working at Coinbase .

As a Senior Associate, Broker Dealer Operations, you'll join the Coinbase Capital Markets (CCM) team and serve as a subject-matter expert within the operational engine supporting Coinbase's U.S. equities brokerage business. This team keeps customer accounts, trades, cash, positions, transfers, corporate actions, and regulatory reporting accurate, controlled, and scalable. You'll independently manage complex operational workflows, strengthen controls, and partner with Apex and internal teams to turn recurring manual work into reliable processes and tooling.

What you'll do:

• Own recurring broker-dealer operations workflows across one or more areas, including reconciliations, corporate actions, securities transfers, account maintenance, error processing, and regulatory reporting support.

• Perform daily order, trade, position, balance, and cash reconciliations between Coinbase and Apex records, investigating breaks, documenting root causes, and driving resolution to closure.

• Manage complex exceptions and time-sensitive incidents by coordinating remediation across Apex, Engineering, Product, Trading, CX, Compliance, Finance, Legal, and Risk, prioritizing by customer, financial, and regulatory impact.

• Build and maintain audit-ready documentation, including SOPs, runbooks, control checklists, and process maps, translating operational lessons into durable controls.

• Partner with Product and Engineering to define operational requirements, test new functionality, validate launch readiness, and improve tooling, dashboards, and automation.

• Identify systemic failure modes and lead process-improvement initiatives that reduce manual work, improve detection and recovery speed, and strengthen operational resilience.

Required skills and experience:

• 5+ years in financial services operations, broker-dealer operations, clearing and settlement, trade support, or a related operational control function, with direct experience in the U.S. equities trade lifecycle (order processing, settlement, positions, cash movements, corporate actions, securities transfers).

• Proven ability to independently manage complex operational issues across multiple systems, driving investigation, escalation, remediation, and closure without relying on existing runbooks for every scenario.

• Track record of authoring or materially improving SOPs, runbooks, controls documentation, or audit-support materials in a regulated environment.

• Hands-on experience with clearing firm or broker-dealer systems (Apex Clearing, Apex Ascend, or equivalent), plus working proficiency in SQL, Jira, and data-quality or workflow-automation tooling.

• Experience partnering with Engineering and Product to convert operational requirements into tooling, alerts, dashboards, or automated workflows.

• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

title: Scientist, Model Validation and Experimental Data Analysis
tags: Stellarator Architecture, Plasma Modelling & Research, Numerical Optimization
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

TEAM AND ROLE

- Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant - Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

- Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in industry - Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

- Build real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world - Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

- You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

- You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

- Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

- Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

You will make Proxima's plasma simulation stack trustworthy by confronting it with reality. Every prediction we make for Alpha - Proxima's Q>1 experimental stellarator - and for Stellaris, our commercial power plant, rests on models whose credibility has to be earned against real measurements from an operating device.

W7-X is where we earn it. You will take our integrated modeling framework, FUS3, and our Bayesian plasma state estimation workflow to W7-X data: reconstruct the plasma state from diagnostic measurements, compare our predictive models against what the machine actually did, and turn the discrepancies into a prioritized map of where our physics is right, where it is not, and what we must fix before Alpha's first plasma. Modeling sits on Alpha's operational critical path and cannot be backfilled after first plasma - this role is how we get ahead of it.

You will be the person in the group who lives at the intersection of modeling and experiment: fluent enough in the physics to know what a model should predict, and close enough to the diagnostics to know what the data can actually support.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Validate Proxima's predictive plasma models against W7-X experimental data - neoclassical and turbulent transport, 3D equilibrium, ECRH deposition, pellet fueling and drift, bootstrap current and iota evolution - and record each comparison as a reproducible validation report with quantitative agreement metrics, stated limitations, and a pinned regression test

- Reconstruct the plasma state from real diagnostic measurements using our time-dependent Bayesian state-estimation workflow (Thomson scattering, interferometry, CXRS, ECE, XICS, bolometry, magnetics), with calibrated uncertainties, and benchmark it against established analyses such as Minerva/IDA reconstructions and ASTRA power-balance res

description:
SENIOR DATA GOVERNANCE ANALYST
We are seeking a Senior Data Governance Analyst who will play an integral role in the execution of the banks enterprise data governance framework and supports the Senior Manager Analytics and Governance who has primary responsibility for enterprise-wide data governance activities.
The incumbent is responsible for monitoring and maintaining a robust data governance environment primarily through data risk assessments and ensuring the timely assignment and remediation of data incidents. The Senior Data Governance Analyst is the liaison between data governance team and business unit data stewards in ensuring that data management policies and procedures are communicated and embedded within the lines of business. As a Senior Data Governance Analyst, you will play an active role throughout the entire engagement cycle, specializing in solutions covering data governance, data quality and data classification.
Responsibilities:

• Administers the Enterprise Data Governance programme by creating processes in support of data management practices to ensure compliance with the banks data governance and management policies.

• Reviews data management practices in collaboration with the Senior Manager to ensure that the business is both aware of developments and operates within the Governance framework. This will include making recommendations to the Senior Manager on any updates that are required to processes, policies or business activities.

• Analyze the effectiveness of data management processes and procedures in Technology and lines of businesses to identify and close gaps and reduce material data risks.

• Conducts in depth monitoring of adherence data management processes to ensure compliance with regulatory authorities and data management standards.

• Develops and maintains key effective relationships with unit leaders, data owners, data stewards and data custodians ensuring that there is clarity and consistency in methodology and practices for data management and governance throughout and across the business units.

• Assists the Senior Manager and accountable officers in assessing data risks arising from all projects, products and change initiatives impacting the Line of Businesses (LOB) to ensure that material risks are appropriately identified and mitigated.

• Provides support to data owners and stewards responsible for resolving data incidents under their purview and developing achievable action plans with realistic due dates to ensure that data incidents are remediated within agreed timeframe.

• Monitors and tracks Data Incidents by attending weekly or monthly meetings (data quality working group etc.) to ensure that action plan owners are executing remedial actions as scheduled thereby minimising exposure.

Requirements:

• 7 10 years banking experience, with a proven background in governance and control functions inclusive of the KCARs, SOX and quarterly assertion processes.

• Understanding of banking data environment.

• Knowledge of data governance practices, business and technology issues related to management of enterprise information assets and approaches related to data management.

• Demonstrated consulting skills, with change management concepts and strategies, including communication, culture change and performance measurement design.

• Experience in risk management, control testing, remediation management and reporting.

• In-depth understanding of process improvement, risk, control and deficiency management to provide leadership to the business units.

• Good understanding of end-to-end banking process flows to be able to develop controls in the context of new process development and providing a good basis for identifying risk and the absence of control.

• Bachelors degree preferably in quantitative areas such as Computer Science or Information Technology.

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
About the Role
Abnormal AI is seeking a Senior Security Engineer to ensure Abnormal’s FedRAMP environment operates securely, resiliently, and efficiently. This role focuses on security operations engineering, with responsibilities spanning CI/CD pipelines, access management, patch management, change reviews, incident response, and security automation. The engineer will directly own and improve the technical workflows that keep Abnormal Gov systems compliant and resilient at scale. The ideal candidate combines deep cloud and infrastructure security expertise with operational discipline, and is AI-enabled to maximize efficiency and reduce overhead.
What you will do

• Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines to support secure deployments and infrastructure workflows.

• Manage infrastructure-as-code (IaC) PR and Change Control Board reviews, ensuring changes are tested, approved, and secure before release.

• Perform security impact analyses (SIAs) for system/application changes and provide recommendations.

• Run OS and infrastructure patch cycles; manage hardened images and patch workflows for FedRAMP environments.

• Govern access management, including account provisioning, RBAC module maintenance, and periodic reviews.

• Manage logging and monitoring pipelines; tune SIEM ingestion and alerting for coverage and accuracy.

• Triage and respond to security incidents, from alert investigation through containment, recovery, and after-action reporting.

• Maintain and refine runbooks, SOPs, and documentation to ensure consistent operations and audit readiness.

• Collaborate with DevInfra, FedOps, Product, and Compliance teams to embed secure practices into operations and development.

Must Haves

• 5 - 7 years in security engineering or infrastructure operations within federal or regulated cloud environments.

• Strong familiarity with NIST 800-53 controls and continuous monitoring practices.

• Proven delivery of AWS/SaaS security best practices.

• Hands-on expertise with CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and IaC security practices.

• Experience in patch management, hardened baselines, and secure image pipelines.

• Strong knowledge of identity and access management (IAM) design and enforcement in large-scale environments.

• Proven ability to manage SIEM pipelines and lead Tier 1/ Tier 2 incident response.

• Strong technical documentation, collaboration, and incident/project management skills.

Nice to Have

• Experience integrating security automation into CI/CD pipelines and SecOps workflows.

• Prior experience supporting federal audits or 3PAO engagements.

• Knowledge of SaaS security operations and monitoring at scale.

• Experience driving automation in security operations, compliance tracking, and evidence management.

• Knowledge of SaaS security operations and modern cloud environments; exposure to DevSecOps pipelines or security reviews for Terraform/containers.

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most-their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

THE ROLE

Abridge is growing from one product into a platform, creating new ways to serve health systems and reach different buyers. Each opportunity brings choices about the offer and the commercial motion that will make it work.

You will own those choices for a focused set of commercial priorities, from the first hypothesis through a tested recommendation. You will determine which buyers to pursue and build an offer around the problem they need to solve. Pricing and packaging will be central to that work, alongside the economic case and the path to a sale.

This is a senior individual contributor role on the Commercial Strategy team. You will do the analysis and write the first draft yourself, working closely with colleagues who bring product expertise and customer context. Your work should give leadership a clear decision and give the field an offer a buyer can understand and carry forward internally.

You will carry each body of work through an initial test and a clear handoff to the teams responsible for execution. The role requires commercial judgment and the ability to finish work that others can use.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Setting direction

- Recommend where we focus next and finish the work we choose. Compare opportunities against the resources and dependencies each requires. Agree on the decision to resolve and the handoff with the teams involved. Drive the work to a conclusion, raising unresolved choices early enough to keep it moving.

title: Head of Product
description:
About Hashgraph:

Hashgraph is a fast-growing software company committed to supporting, developing and servicing Hedera, an open source, proof-of-stake platform. Hedera is EVM-compatible and has been specifically built to meet the needs of enterprise and web3 applications, which require speed, security, stability and sustainability. Hedera’s public network is governed by industry-leading organizations, spanning 11 sectors and 14 regions who oversee the development and direction of the decentralized platform.

Why this role exists:

Assets are landing on ledgers faster than anyone has built a way to move them between ledgers. Collateral sits on one chain while the position it should be margining sits on another. Delivery-versus-payment and payment-versus-payment both work inside a single ledger and both break the moment the two legs live in different places. The available workarounds are bridges, which have lost more than $2.8 billion since 2021.

The team that built Hedera from the ground up is now building a cross-ledger solution for institutional settlement: collateral mobility, DvP, PvP, cross-border payments, and FX across public and private ledgers that do not otherwise interoperate.

Your job will be to define the product and own the roadmap. You will report to the founder.

In this role, you will:

- Own the product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and roadmap.

- Work closely with business development on go-to-market execution for the product. Define the product the market needs and business development can sell..

- Report product status and roadmap changes directly to the founders and executive team.

- Design and run trials with external validators, partners, and customers.

- Make the release readiness call on performance, security, and usability. Ask the tough questions before launch, not after.

- Run program management across every stakeholder group. Keep BD, Marketing, and Engineering in sync.

What success looks like in 12 months:

- Live settlement for the priority use cases of cross-border payments, settlements, treasury management, and tokenized deposits, with named institutional counterparties moving real value.

- You will have built working on/off-ramps supporting the use cases above.

- BD, marketing, and engineering each independently say you are the reason they are shipping faster.

What you bring:

Core capabilities:

- 10+ years in product management, product leadership, or an equivalent operating role.

- 5+ years of that inside FX, payments, settlement, clearing, custody, collateral management, or banking infrastructure.

- Real operating experience in FX exchange, payments, settlement, or banking-rail businesses. You understand cross-border payments, stablecoins, on/off-ramps, and how players like SWIFT and Stripe fit together.

- Direct working knowledge of at least two of: FX execution and settlement, cross-border payments, DvP or PvP settlement, collateral mobility, treasury operations, tokenized deposits.

Functional expertise:

- Experience owning a roadmap end to end, including making the right, hard calls.

- Experience writing product requirements that an engineering team built from directly.

- Experience presenting to executives, boards, or institutional steering committees.

Preferred skills and experience:

- Distributed ledger or Layer 1 experience.

- Work inside a consortium, governing council, or member-owned network model.

- Exposure to CCIP, Circle and ARC, Canton, Ripple, or comparable enterprise platforms.

- Stablecoin mechanics, on-ramps and off-ramps, tokenized collateral.

- First product hire or zero-to-one experience at an early-stage company.

Candidates who meet the basic qualifications and none of the preferred should still apply. The preferred list is learnable in a quarter.

Travel to customer, validator, and partner sites, including international travel will be required.

title: Principal Product Manager, Billing & Marketplaces

ClickHouse Cloud, the fully managed version of the open source ClickHouse database, is available on AWS, GCP, and Azure. title: Gas Lead
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

Role Scope

- Negotiate behind-the-meter PPAs, tolling agreements, and heat rate options with generation owners and developers for multi-hundred-megawatt data center campuses.

- Negotiate gas supply, transport, and basis arrangements that lock in fuel price and deliverability for each behind-the-meter site before the build starts.

- Diligence prospective behind-the-meter gas sites for pipeline access, fuel constraints, air permitting, and power delivery risk before we commit to a lease.

- Evaluate generation equipment (for example turbines and reciprocating engines) on heat rate, availability, lead time, emissions, and delivered cost, and turn it into a clear recommendation for leadership.

- Quarterback development, engineering, legal, and finance from site selection through executed supply contracts to energization, and flag cost and schedule exposure before it reaches leadership.

What We’re Looking For

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don’t fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

- You’ve personally negotiated behind-the-meter PPAs, tolls, or heat rate options where the economics had to hold through project finance and final deal terms.

- You’ve negotiated gas supply agreements and managed fixed-price, index, and basis exposure, and you know which fuel constraints break a plant’s dispatch.

- You’ve diligenced a gas-fired site from pipeline access and fuel deliverability through air permits and power delivery, and you know what kills a site early.

- You’ve compared generation technologies on heat rate, spark-spread economics, and reliability, and your analysis drove an equipment decision.

- You’ve built the techno-economic models behind these deals and defended the sensitivities to lenders, investors, or executives.

- You quarterback across engineering, legal, finance, and operations, and you write clearly enough to distill a technical question into a decision and a next step for a CEO.

- Bonus: Multi-market power experience (ERCOT, PJM, MISO, WECC). Plant dispatch and fuel optimization (generator, asset manager, or trading desk). Large-load and utility interconnection. Pipeline capacity and midstream contracting.

We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

The Senior Cloud Engineer will play a key role in modernizing our infrastructure, improving network resiliency, and driving automation through services like CloudFormation / Azure Resource Manager (ARM), Terraform, Systems Manager / Azure Automation, and AWS Config / Azure Policy.

title: Werkstudent/in Finance - Fördermittelmanagement (w/m/d)
description:
Über uns:

Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.

Wir laden dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben - indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit deinem Wissen und deinen Fähigkeiten kannst du beweisen, dass Dinge anders - und besser - gemacht werden können.

Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.

Unsere Technology:

Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.

Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.

Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.

Die Rolle

Als Werkstudent/in im Bereich Fördermittelmanagement erhältst du spannende Einblicke in die Schnittstelle zwischen Finance, Projektförderung und Digitalisierung. Du unterstützt unser Finance-Team bei öffentlich geförderten Forschungsprojekten und arbeitest an Themen wie Reporting, Datenaufbereitung und Prozessoptimierung.

Bei uns kannst du Finance nicht nur im Tagesgeschäft kennenlernen, sondern auch aktiv mitgestalten: Wir hinterfragen bestehende Abläufe, entwickeln neue Prozesse und nutzen moderne Technologien wie KI, um unsere Arbeit effizienter zu machen. Wenn du gerne mit Zahlen arbeitest, neugierig auf neue Technologien bist und eigene Ideen einbringen möchtest, freuen wir uns auf dich!

Das sollte dich begeistern

- Einblicke in die Finanzierung öffentlich geförderter Forschungsprojekte und Mitarbeit am Fördermittelreporting

- Analyse und Prüfung von Finanz- und Stundendaten sowie Unterstützung bei finanziellen Nachweisen

- Mitgestaltung digitaler und KI-gestützter Prozesse zur Automatisierung und Optimierung unserer Finance-Abläufe

- Mitarbeit bei der Einführung unseres neuen ERP-Systems und der Weiterentwicklung unserer Daten- und Reportingstrukturen

Das bringst du idealerweise mit

- Du studierst Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang und hast ein gutes Zahlenverständnis

- Du arbeitest sorgfältig und zuverlässig, bist gut organisiert und kommunizierst gerne

- Du hast gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse und gehst sicher mit MS Office, insbesondere Excel, um

- Du bist IT-affin, lernst gerne Neues und hast Interesse an Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und KI. Kenntnisse in SAP sind ein Plus

Unsere Kultur

Menschen vor Prozessen. Bei Black Semiconductor ist Flexibilität der Schlüssel - wir sorgen dafür, dass sich die Arbeit dem Leben anpasst und nicht umgekehrt. Wir setzen uns für die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben ein, damit Karrieren sinnvoll und bereichernd sind. Unsere Prozesse sind menschenzentriert, damit du dich auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren können.

Lassen Sie uns gemeinsam wachsen. Dein Potenzial ist unsere Priorität. Wir bieten dir die nötige Autonomie, um etwas zu bewirken, und fördern dein Wachstum durch eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Wir investieren in deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung.

As Fleet Coordinator - Last Mile, you will own day-to-day last-mile ground operations and real-time traffic control across our hubs and pickup/drop points in Delhi NCR - making sure passengers move smoothly between buses and cabs, cab operators deliver to standard, and your ground team runs like clockwork.

About The Role

• Lead and manage day-to-day last-mile ground operations and real-time traffic control across designated hubs and pickup/drop points in Delhi NCR.

• Ensure smooth, timely dispatch and coordination of last-mile cabs against bus arrival and departure schedules.

• Act as the on-ground escalation point, resolving operational disruptions (delays, no-shows, route changes, demand surges) quickly and calmly.

• Work closely with last-mile cab operators and drivers to drive app adoption, improve punctuality metrics, and elevate customer experience.

• Coach and support drivers on FlixBus standards, app usage, and service expectations.

• Manage the roster, shift planning, and day-to-day working of ground operations associates and last-mile associates.

• Allocate manpower against demand patterns and peak windows; track attendance, performance, and productivity of the ground team.

• Own last-mile cab operator governance - share performance reports regularly, run periodic review meetings, and manage the day-to-day partner relationship.

• Track operator SLAs and KPIs, flag underperformance, and drive corrective action plans.

• Be the owner of last-mile passenger experience, ensuring a smooth transition from buses to cabs and cabs to buses.

• Monitor passenger feedback and complaints related to the last mile, close the loop, and drive continuous improvement.

About You

• 3-6 years of experience in ground operations, last-mile logistics, fleet coordination, transport operations, or a similar field (mobility, ride-hailing, e-commerce delivery, or aggregator platforms preferred).

• Proven experience managing frontline teams and third-party vendors or operators.

• Strong grasp of punctuality/SLA-driven operations and comfort working with real-time, on-ground decision-making.

• Data-literate - comfortable working with dashboards, spreadsheets, and reporting; able to turn numbers into action.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; able to hold operators accountable while maintaining strong relationships.

• Customer-first mindset with a bias for quick problem resolution.

• Working knowledge of Delhi NCR geography, traffic patterns, and transport hubs is a strong advantage.

• Willingness to work in shifts, be on-ground, and be reachable during operational hours.

• Bachelor's degree preferred; proficiency in English and Hindi.

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

What We Offer

• Opportunity to work in a rapidly scaling start-up .

• Play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless execution of our intercity travel operations, ground operational excellence, data analysis and vendor management processes.

• Hone your stakeholder management skills by interacting with international stakeholders.

Why Join Flix

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.

If you’re looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

title: Advanced Clinical Expert, CardioMEMS - New York/New Jersey
description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 115,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries. JOB DESCRIPTION:

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an active open requisition. We are building a candidate slate for a future opening.

At Abbott , you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

• Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

• Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year

• A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.

In Abbott ’s Heart Failure (HF) business, we’re developing solutions to diagnose, monitor and manage heart failure, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

The Advanced Clinical Expert is accountable for providing educational and clinical support to the field in response to the most complex inquiries from physicians, health care professionals, patients and sales staff. Performs work that involves a high degree of independence. Work is reviewed upon milestones and upon completion for soundness of judgment and overall adequacy/accuracy. Contributions affect team/organization results. Performs assignments of moderate complexity, resolves difficult problems using intellectual capabilities, ingenuity and advanced scientific principles; completes reports and makes oral presentations; consistent use of independent judgment. What You’ll Work On

• Proactively manage key partner relationships to strengthen overall solution capabilities and drive greater client value and CardioMEMS program adoption.

• Analyzes Market Dynamics to identify greatest needs and opportunities.

• Demonstrates ability to build and sustain credible business relationships with customers and shares product expertise accordingly.

• Provides technical, sales, education, and clinical support in response to the most complex field inquiries. Demonstrates a thorough command of all HF products, related product and technical knowledge, trends, and players.

• Provides provider/facility adoption direction, system training, workflow development, test planning support, and communications support to the client and implementation team.

• Collaborates cross functionally with Sales, Marketing, and Training and Development to provide feedback for improved customer experience and optimize implementation processes.

• Act as Advanced Clinical Expert internally within defined targeted accounts and within the Abbott HF organization.

• Develops, leads and/or facilitates trainings and other programs on HF products to healthcare professionals.

• Remains current on developments in field(s) of expertise, regulatory requirements, and a good working knowledge of company and competitor products, markets, and objectives as well as industry trends.

• Has exceptional communication skills along with confidence

title: Senior Cloud Native Consultant
description:
Report To: Consulting Delivery manager
Employment Status: Full Time
Salary: Up to £110,000 + Benefits
Who is ControlPlane?
ControlPlane is a London-headquartered consultancy specialising in cloud-native, Kubernetes, and open-source security solutions. Our expertise lies in helping organisations adopt and secure complex cloud infrastructures by implementing security measures that are "secure-by-design" and "secure-by-default." This engineering excellence drives ControlPlane deep into cybersecurity, providing services like zero-trust architectures, threat modeling, supply chain security, and platform engineering.
We are acclaimed for our work in highly regulated industries, such as finance, healthcare, and national infrastructure. We help clients consume next-generation and open-source projects safely and securely. In addition to consulting, we are active contributors to the open-source community supporting projects like Flux CD, OpenBao, and FINOS AI Readiness.
What We’re Looking For in a Cloud Native Consultant
We are looking for cloud native engineers and consultants at all levels to represent the technical and cultural values of ControlPlane, leading our customers by example in the complex and fast-changing world of cloud native technology. You will perform a mix of client consulting, working on internal labs projects, and contributing to Open Source projects on ControlPlane’s behalf.
This is a remote position, but we invite you to spend time in person at our London office: this is optional and we aim to be entirely flexible to your needs.
As part of the engineering team we may ask you to be involved in pre-sales or business development activities to support the ongoing growth of our organisation.
Role, Responsibilities and Requirements of Our Cloud Native Consultant
What you'll bring (Essential):

• Experience and a deep understanding of Kubernetes using GKE, EKS or OpenShift

• Experience with one or more cloud providers and Infrastructure as Code tools and practices

• Experience with GitOps tooling such as FluxCD or ArgoCD

• Development experience with Golang, Python, or Java

• Understanding of CI/CD best practices and a range of build tools

• Cloud security awareness and a desire to build hardened systems

• Customer facing/Consulting experience.

What you'll bring (Desirable):

• Experience with SPIFFE/SPIRE

• Experience with Hashicorp Vault/OpenBao

• Experience with Zero Trust Architectures, tools and practices

Benefits
ControlPlane is a dynamic, cutting-edge and passionate business to work for. Our employees are at the heart of our business, which means we care about our culture, our people and their progression.
Alongside this, as a colleague you will have the following benefits:

• Generous and competitive salary + Bonus

• 33 days of paid holiday, including paid leave for the standard 8 UK Bank Holidays

• Enhanced Parental Leave

• Private Medical and Dental Insurance

• An individual training budget for personal development, including but not limited to:

• Conferences

• Training (books, courses, coaching, as well as internal training which is of course included beyond budget)

• Qualifications

We are looking for technical practitioners who can work with our clients and the team to deliver these projects and help establish ControlPlane as a world-class technical thought leader.
We believe our peers are equally as important as the technology we use. We’re looking for people of the highest personal calibre, quietly confident, with a good work ethic, keenness to learn, emotional maturity and respect, who know that “we” is more than “me”, and who embrace human diversity of all kinds. As we grow you will help us to build a company culture of which we can all be proud. If you espouse these values, we want you!

NOTE FOR RECRUITMENT AGENCIES: Please do not call or email our team speculatively; we do not accept unsolicited CVs.

title: Lead SailPoint Solutions Engineer
description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Lead SailPoint Solutions Engineer is the senior technical execution owner responsible for designing, implementing, and sustaining Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) solutions across the organization. Working in close partnership with the Lead IGA Solutions Architect, this role is accountable for translating architectural strategy, reference designs, and governance models into scalable, supportable, and operational IGA implementations-primarily within SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC).

This position serves as the authoritative engineering lead for the IGA platform. While the Lead IGA Solutions Architect defines the what and why of enterprise IGA design, the Lead IGA Solutions Engineer owns the how ensuring that identity lifecycle automation, access governance, and integrations are engineered consistently, securely, and in alignment with approved architectural direction. The Lead SailPoint Solutions Engineer is responsible for translating enterprise IGA architecture into reliable, scalable, and operationally sound solutions while providing technical leadership across delivery, platform operations, and engineering maturity.

• Serve as the lead technical owner for IGA solution delivery and platform execution in partnership with the Lead IGA Solutions Architect.

• Ensure engineering solutions align with enterprise architecture, standards, and reference patterns while remaining scalable, supportable, and operationally sound.

• Lead implementation of identity lifecycle and governance capabilities, including joiner/mover/leaver workflows, birthright access, certifications, access requests, RBAC/ABAC, and separation-of-duties controls.

• Translate regulatory, audit, and risk requirements into enforceable technical controls and consistent implementation practices.

• Lead engineering for integrations across HR systems, directories, cloud platforms, and enterprise applications, including mapping, transformation, reconciliation, monitoring, and exception handling.

• Own platform reliability, technical health, automation, and engineering standards, including deployment, version control, and change management.

• Partner with cross-functional teams to align design, delivery, and roadmap priorities across IGA initiatives.

• Mentor and coach engineers on implementation standards, integration practices, and operational excellence to strengthen delivery consistency and engineering maturity.

Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

• SailPoint Certified Identity Now Engineer certification.

• 5+ years of hands‑on experience in identity engineering, security engineering, or software solution delivery.

• Strong hands‑on experience with SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC), including lifecycle workflows, access governance, and integrations.

• Proven experience engineering system and application integrations using APIs, SCIM, and enterprise data flows.

• Demonstrated ability to act as technical owner for a platform or domain, including accountability for delivery quality and operational outcomes.

• Experience developing automation, scripts, or tooling to support identity onboarding, migrations, or operational processes.

• Proficiency with version control and structured deployment or release workflows.

• Strong independent problem‑solving capability with minimal oversight.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical decisions and tradeoffs.

Preferred Qualifications

• Advanced SailPoint ISC experience, including custom connectors, complex workflows, and policy‑driven access models.

• Experience implementing RBAC, ABAC, birthright access policies, certifications, and separation‑of‑duties controls at enterprise scale.

• Background integrating IGA platforms with HR systems, ERP platforms, SaaS applications, and cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).

• Familiarity with identity standards and protocols

title: CC How to Think Freelance Writer
description:
Freelance Writer

How do we make decisions? argue? persuade? research? evaluate? Basically, how do we think? This course will pull together insights across disciplines to explore all the ways we can think about thinking and apply it in our lives. If you’re an experienced writer, researcher, and thinker who can explain complex topics in clear and creative ways, we’d love to hear from you!

Crash Course, owned by Complexly , is an award-winning YouTube channel that invites students, teachers, and lifelong learners to tackle subjects they might have had trouble with or are curious to learn more about. Our videos take traditional classroom concepts and combine them with engaging and insightful narratives to help people learn and understand.

More details on the position:

Job Title: Writer

Status: Freelance

Reports to: Script Editor

Location: Remote, US-Based

Term: Beginning January 2027

Pay: $800 per script

What you'll do:

Write approximately 10 scripts, each ~1800-2000 words for our Crash Course How to Think series. These scripts will be based on episode outlines created by the Complexly editorial team, but writers are expected to provide additional research, insights, and ideas to create accurate and engaging scripts.

We’re looking for a deep thinker who can take an interdisciplinary approach, pulling from the sciences and humanities to help us guide viewers to reflect and deepen their understanding of how to ask questions, build knowledge, evaluate and share information, and make decisions. We’re particularly interested in candidates with experience “thinking about thinking.” Fields that come to mind include philosophy, education, psychology, or communication.

About Complexly :

Complexly is a media company that produces shows like Crash Course, SciShow, Eons, Ask Hank Anything, Bizarre Beasts, Study Hall, and more. We were founded by John and Hank Green with a mission of creating trustworthy stuff and lowering barriers to knowledge building. The world is not simple. And that can seem like a burden sometimes. The reality is, the human species will never fully understand itself or its universe, let alone any individual. But instead of seeing that as a failing, we'd like to suggest that the process is as powerful as the outcome.

Complexly was a company privately owned by Hank and John Green. As of 2026, they have donated the company to the public as a new nonprofit 501c3 organization, which will help Complexly fulfill its mission for decades to come. Becoming a nonprofit means we will be able to lean into public support, supercharging our mission to make content the world needs, not what is optimized for advertisers.

title: Mission Engineer II - Grand Rapids
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

This isn't a relationship management role. It's an ownership role. Sharp. Adaptable. Unstoppable. As a Mission Engineer II, you'll work directly alongside public safety agencies to turn real operational challenges into working technical solutions.

You'll spend time with the people doing the work, understand how the agency operates, identify problems worth solving, and use Axon tools, AI, automation, data, and the broader Axon ecosystem to build against them. 

Building is the core of the role, but customer needs come first. Because you're embedded with the agency, you'll also become a go-to technical resource who understands their Axon environment and helps them navigate critical needs when they arise. You may help quarterback an upcoming deployment, coordinate a complex technical issue, or connect the right Axon teams around an agency priority.

You won't replace Support, Deployment, Product, or other teams. You'll bring technical continuity, help connect the dots, and use what you learn to identify the next opportunity to build something better. Mission Engineers don't measure success by activity. They measure it by what gets built, what gets used, and what changes because of it.

What You’ll Do

Location: On Site with travel
Reports To: Manager or Senior Manager of Mission Engineering

Discover the Mission

• Embed with assigned agencies to understand their mission, people, workflows, systems, and priorities.

• Develop broad knowledge of the Axon ecosystem and deeper expertise in the products deployed at your agency.

• Work with frontline users, technical teams, and agency leadership to uncover operational friction.

• Translate customer problems into clear technical requirements and measurable success criteria.

• Identify opportunities for AI, automation, data, and Axon capabilities to improve how the agency operates.

• Understand what the customer needs-not simply what they initially ask for.

Build With the Platform

• Build applications, dashboards, workflows, automations, and using Axon products and other approved Axon tools.

• Apply foundational software engineering concepts including APIs, data structures, scripting, testing, debugging, and version control.

• Use AI and AI-assisted development tools responsibly within Axon's approved development and security environment.

• Configure and extend capabilities across Axon's technology ecosystem.

• Understand when you can solve the problem yourself and when deeper Product or Engineering partnership is required.

• Build with Axon-not around it.

Transform Builds Into Outcomes

• Move solutions from discovery into real customer use.

• Test and iterate alongside the people who will actually use what you build.

• Drive adoption and measure results against agreed success criteria.

• Continue improving solutions until they create sustained operational value.

• Document successful solutions so they can be maintained, improved, and reused.

Be the Agency's Go-To Technical Resource

• Maintain a consistent onsite presence and deep understanding of the agency's Axon environment.

• Lean into critical customer needs when your technical context or involvement can materially improve the outcome.

• Help quarterback technical alignment around important deployments without replacing the teams responsible for deployment execution.

• Serve as a liaison when complex technical issues require coordination
